title: Exactness of affine K-injective boundaries
statement: Let f:X\to Y be affine and I a K-injective cochain complex of O_X-modules with quasi-coherent cohomology in every integer degree. Write F=g_* for direct image to modules over f_*O_X. For n in Z let h be the left part of the chosen homology data of I.sc n, with differential into cycles h.fprime and class projection h.pi. The short complex F(I^{n-1}) -> F(h.K) -> F(h.H), whose maps are F(h.fprime) and F(h.pi), is exact at its middle object. No epimorphy of its second map, left adjoint or adjunction is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0AVW, proof, canonical cohomology calculation; Tag 08D4, N=1 truncation argument; Tag 08BS, restriction of K-injectives to opens

proof.text: Use left exactness of direct image and the raw/derived upper-truncation comparisons. Apply degree-n homology to naturality of the derived unit for tau<=n I -> I. Both vertical arrows and the unit at K-injective I are invertible, hence so is the unit at tau<=n I. Thus upperTruncationBoundaryComparison is invertible.

The affine upper-truncation edge is an isomorphism from derived homology to pushed chosen homology, whose composite after the cokernel projection is the pushed class map. Cancel the cokernel projection to identify the induced cokernel desc with the composite of two isomorphisms. It is monic, so Mathlib exact_iff_mono_cokernel_desc proves the required exactness.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0AVW cycle calculation and Tag 08D4, formalized by upper-truncation naturality and cokernel monicity.

theorem affine_algebra_kinjective_boundary_exactness
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] (hI : ∀ n : ℤ, (I.homology n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ) :
    ((ShortComplex.mk (I.sc n).homologyData.left.f' (I.sc n).homologyData.left.π
      (I.sc n).homologyData.left.f'_π).map
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))).Exact
